objections.title: Some fixture rejection sentences are stronger than the general fairness rule
objections.failure_trace_or_prerequisite: The common contract correctly says a fixed player ESCAPE cannot veto a valid warning when another affordable response exists. C01 says a wall/recovery invalidating its exact escape rejects the warning; C04 says a warning conflicting with its exact route is not admitted; C06 says to reject/delay a warning its fixed route cannot afford. These can be read as fixture-only statements, but none states that this rejection follows only when no other affordable response exists. A failed example witness should not automatically become a world rejection.

evidence.rationale: General existential fairness, no player route veto.
Exact-escape invalidity is followed by warning rejection.
Exact projected route conflict is followed by nonadmission.
Fixed-route affordability is followed by reject/delay.

objections.required_to_close: Make these examples explicitly conditional fixture evidence: if their chosen escape fails, that example is not a usable policy witness. General warning rejection/delay requires no affordable response under the existing commitment contract, or a declared fixture in which that route is the only one. Keep the warning/fixed-policy distinction and do not erase any earlier commitment.
objections.claim_ceiling: Written critique; no executed failure or impossibility proof.

objections.title: Completed one-shot routes have no reactivation rule
objections.failure_trace_or_prerequisite: Common MOVE resumes a retained cursor, STOP/switch suspend it, and restart is allowed only at pause or phase initialization. This closes interruption-resume but does not state how a completed one-shot EXIT, CONTACT_A or lure route works when the hero later leaves its endpoint. C02 repeats an H cast and needs EXIT again; C03 may need CONTACT_A after the first shove; C05 revisits a lure during later cycles. A completed route may be a final-waypoint posture or a retired one-shot, but the contract does not choose. No actual runtime bug is claimed.

evidence.rationale: Explicit suspension and restricted restart; terminal reactivation omitted.
H_WAIT_CAST/EXIT/M loop requires recurring outward casts.
Reuses EXIT for each inside-origin cast.
CONTACT_A is a fixed approach reused for teaching hits.
Requires ordinary return to A before second teaching hit.
Recurring positioning can reuse a previously completed lure.

objections.required_to_close: Define bounded completed-route reuse/final-target behavior and how physical displacement affects actual arrival. Give a repeated EXIT/contact or lure example using that rule. Preserve STOP suspension and consumed cast/mark latches; a new MOVE must not reset those by accident. Allow only declared straight/segment connections, never hidden route search.
objections.claim_ceiling: Written critique; no executed failure or impossibility proof.

objections.title: Post-admission obstruction can strand active coverage
objections.failure_trace_or_prerequisite: The fresh request is consumed at coverage admission. The route can discard if blocked/unreachable under admission, but the text does not specify a later obstruction during ordinary approach or require actual arrival before windup. The request expiry no longer owns a consumed request, and the three-second hold is downstream of approach. An approach blocked after admission therefore has no explicit abort/deadline/continuation outcome and can retain the single coverage capacity indefinitely. Known changing geometry and player walls make this a named branch, not speculative future scale.

evidence.rationale: Request is consumed once at coverage admission.
Initial route admission/discard, then windup/hold, without post-admission obstruction branch.
Capacity release follows approach/windup/hold or owner exit.
Coverage approach obstacles are already within the frame.

objections.required_to_close: State actual anchor arrival before windup and one bounded post-admission approach obstruction disposition/terminal owner. A finite abort or explicitly bounded wait can close it and return normal behavior; do not teleport, choose an alternate route or refund the consumed teaching events. Keep later memory unable to retarget active coverage.
objections.claim_ceiling: Written critique; no executed failure or impossibility proof.

objections.title: Scout route deadline must not silently govern every actor passage

The scout deadline branch is repaired, but the condition is not actor-qualified. Hero and other actors also use the current-law gate; when the scout is returning or absent, a generic reading would reject their passage despite an open gate. The intended scout-only condition is plausible, but should be explicit rather than inferred.

evidence.rationale: WEST passage condition includes scout commitment time without an actor qualifier.
Hero/scout share physical source trigger rights.
Current gate can supply hero transit.

Qualify the extra deadline test to that scout commitment and retain one owner for an already admitted passage. This adds no new mechanic and must not make hero/manual passage depend on an unrelated enemy clock.
